Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live''

Indian  Standard 

SPECIFICATION  FOR 
ABDOMINAL  BELTS 


CD 
"CJ 

c 

(0 

CQ 


0) 

a. 
w 

3 

w 

C 


1.  Scope  —  Covers  material   and  dimensional   requirements   (which   are    independent    of    individual 
clinical  requirements  )  for  abdominal  belts. 

2.  Material 

2.1  Body —  Good  quality  white  satin  or  drill;  or  inner  lining  of  canvas  cloth  and  outer  cover  of  good 
quality  coloured  poplin  cloth. 

2-2  Elastic  Tape  —  152  mm  wide,  conforming  to  IS  9686-1980  '  Specification  for  elastic  tape  ', 

2.3  Front  Side  —  Good  quality  felt  or  blanket  cloth. 

2.4  Padding  —  Wool,  minimum  95  percent 

2.5  Cotton  Sewing  r/?reac/ —  Conforming  to  Variety  No.  30  of  IS  :  1720-1978  '  Specification  for  cotton 
sewing  threads  (  second  revision  ) '. 

2.6  Fasteners  —  Roller  buckles  with  leather  straps,  hooks  and  loops  or  tapes  50  mm  wide. 

2.7  Reinforcement  —  Polyethylene  strips,  1*5  mm  thick  and  12  mm  wide,  or  tempered  steel  strips,  12  mm 
wide. 

3.  Dimensions  —  The  front  height  and  circumference  shall  be  as  follows: 

Circumference  Front  Height 

mm  mm 

610   to      750  200 

751    to   1  000  225 

1  001  and  above  250 

4.  Manufacture  Workmanship  and  Finish 

4.1  The  abdominal  belts  shall  fit  the  patient  snugly. 

4.2  If  necessary,  extra  understraps  of  elastic  tape  may  be  provided. 

4.3  The  elastic  tape  shall  be  fitted  on  left  side  of  the  belt. 

4.4  All  sewing  shall  be  done  with  lock  stitches  by  turning  in  the  free  ends  to  depth.     The  abdominal 
belt  shall  be  tailored  neatly. 

5.  Marking  —  The  belts  shall  be  clearly  marked  with  the  manufacturer's  name,  initials  or  recognized 
trade-mark. 

5.1   iSl  Certiftccition  Marking  —  Details  available  with  the  Indian  Standards  Institution. 

6.  Packing  —  As  agreed  to  between  the  purchaser  and  the  supplier.
